reviewer_root_cause: DarkColors.onSurfaceVariant = Grey600 #6B6B6B on background/surface Grey900 #121212 = 3.55:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1. The transaction date line in AccountDetailScreen.TransactionRow is bodySmall 12sp coloured onSurfaceVariant, so it fails in dark mode only (light mode uses Grey700 on white, ~9:1). Correct fix is one semantic token in Theme.kt, not a per-screen colour override.
